study_design: Nested case-control study within the Nutritional Prevention of Cancer trial
reason: The abstract assesses prostate cancer risk in a nested case-control analysis but does not define or analyze aggressive incident prostate cancer. It does not explicitly establish prospective biospecimen collection, and the total analytic sample is not directly stated without summing cases and controls.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Using a nested case-control design, we evaluated whether plasma levels of 25(OH)D(3) and 1alpha,25(OH)(2)D(3) were associated with prostate cancer risk in participants from the Nutritional Prevention of Cancer (NPC) trial.
estimate_classifications.reason: The estimate is for general prostate cancer risk; no aggressive disease endpoint is identified.
